entries.owner: fixed guest-RAM global pointer slot; pointed-to table is dynamic
entries.name: Japanese system pointer slot g_system_ptr
entries.evidence: Authenticated original Japanese func_80004170_4D70 decodes LUI/LW pointer load at original ROM 0x4D70/0x4D74. Native decomp symbol map names g_system_ptr at 0x80161DB8; paired independent USA ROM function forms and writes 0x8015C5C8. 32-bit fixed-global slot, +0x57F0 address delta.
entries.context: Value at slot is a dynamic pointer; JP reset clears 16 one-byte records at pointer-relative +0x3B168, not a fixed guest address. USA function at the same code VMA performs different work; full runtime value/lifetime and corresponding field layout are not verified. Never write or dereference automatically.
entries.other_region_evidence: USA NG5E-0 original function at ROM 0x4D8C/0x4D94/0x4D9C writes corresponding 32-bit pointer slot; original USA decomp/system_memory.c names D_8015C5C8_15D1C8.
entries.next_test: Independent read-only USA/JP live initialized-pointer snapshots across the same scene lifecycle; do not assume pointee-layout identity.

entries.evidence: Authenticated original USA func_80004170_4D70 forms and stores 32-bit pointer to fixed guest slot 0x8015C5C8 via LUI/ADDIU/SW at ROM 0x4D8C/0x4D94/0x4D9C. `decomp/system_memory.c` names D_8015C5C8_15D1C8; independently authenticated Japanese ROM loads g_system_ptr at 0x80161DB8. entries.context: Original USA initializer writes pointer; original JP same-named VMA is a different reset function that reads pointer. Mapping is of fixed pointer slots only. Pointee address and offset +0x3B168 are dynamic, not suitable for cross-region arithmetic or toolkit memory writes.
